content: The Void STAND ALONE The void is a book about a wormhole opening over earth showing a planet, we send a mission to this planet only to eventually discover its earth after a catastrophe,  it’s  obviously many years later, no buildings left and new creatures on the planet. NOTES: These are notes on the book that I can add later as I think of things  They. Race to find out what happened to the world  They find out that war has broken out and we killed ourselves  Now they must stop it from happening on our version of earth as they only have weeks before the event occurs.  Come to find out an alien race who found our planet centuries later opened the wormhole to give us a chance to fix our future.  The book ends with us saving ourselves and then getting visited by the aliens in the future, only to find out they are slavers looking for good stock.
